4. **Check each shot as it arrives:** no cut inside it (generate prints `cuts_inside`, and refuses a guide with a cut; pass `--allow-cuts` only when you have read those frames and they are one shot, a whip or a flash), none of the original's text, the face box within 5% of the original's (`npx hyperframes measure face`). Regenerate a failing shot once; then trim it to its good part. A shot HeyGen refuses or fails (`generation_failed`) gets one more try, test calls included, in this session or a resumed one; then stop and ask the person whether to keep the original's footage for now or drop the shot. A shot still waiting when generate stops after 30 minutes gets the same command once more (it picks up the same job and is not charged again); still waiting after that, treat it as failed, and build the rest meanwhile.
5. **Frame it:** scale and move each shot so its face box sits on the original's at the shot's start and end (`npx hyperframes measure face <shot> --against <video> --from a --to b` prints the `scale`, `x`, `y` to set), tweening between them only where the original's camera moves. The framing jumps at cuts and nowhere else.
6. **Text behind the person:** where the original's text passes behind them, cut them out of the shot (`npx hyperframes remove-background <shot> -o <cutout>.webm`) and stack shot, text, cutout.
